name: matchflow-mobile
description: MatchFlow Mobile app packaged with Capacitor

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.release:ios:archive: xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS archive -archivePath ios/App/build/App.xcarchive
scripts.apk:path: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const paths=['release/MatchFlowMobile-debug.apk','releases/MatchFlowMobile-debug.apk'];const found=paths.find(p=>fs.existsSync(p));if(!found){console.error('APK not found in release/ or releases/. Run npm run apk:build');process.exit(1);}const s=fs.statSync(found);console.log(found+' ('+(s.size/1024/1024).toFixed(2)+' MB)');"
